tasks.label: Busted coverage
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $env:Path = "$(luarocks path --lr-bin);$env:Path"; $env:LUA_PATH = "src\?.lua;$(luarocks path --lr-path)"; $env:LUA_CPATH = luarocks path --lr-cpath; foreach ($file in 'luacov.stats.out', 'lcov.info') { if (Test-Path $file) { Remove-Item $file } }; busted --coverage; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; luacov -r lcov src; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Move-Item -Force luacov.report.out lcov.info
